International Coders.Title: Task Distribution and Management
International Coders.Description: Develop a system to distribute tasks to international coders, allowing them to start and end tasks, track time spent, and report progress. This system will ensure efficient task allocation and management.

International Coders.Title: Time Tracking and Reporting
International Coders.Description: Implement a feature to track the time spent on each task by coders. This will compile time data by contract and coder, providing detailed reports for invoicing and project management.

International Coders.Title: Project Kick-Off System
International Coders.Description: Create a project kick-off system that takes detailed plans and distributes tasks to coders. This system will also track the start and end times of tasks, ensuring accurate time tracking and project progress monitoring.

International Coders.Title: Code Analysis and Reporting
International Coders.Description: Develop the Myte Code Checker tool to analyze code changes daily, compare them with the previous day's data, and generate natural language reports. This will help coders understand the changes and updates in the codebase.

International Coders.Title: Communication and Collaboration Tools
International Coders.Description: Implement tools for coders to communicate and collaborate effectively within the platform. This includes messaging, file sharing, and discussion boards to facilitate teamwork and coordination.

International Coders.Title: Access to Project Documentation
International Coders.Description: Provide coders with access to all relevant project documentation, including requirements, epics, stories, and tasks. This will ensure they have all the information needed to complete their tasks efficiently.

International Coders.Title: Performance and Progress Tracking
International Coders.Description: Create a dashboard for coders to view their performance metrics, track their progress on tasks, and receive feedback. This will help them stay on track and improve their productivity.

Social Media Managers.Title: Automated Twitter Management
Social Media Managers.Description: Develop the Myte Twitter tool to research recent AI news, create daily tweet threads, and post them on the company's Twitter account. This tool will ensure consistent and engaging content is shared with the audience.

Social Media Managers.Title: LinkedIn Outreach Automation
Social Media Managers.Description: Implement the Myte Social LinkedIn tool to manage the LinkedIn CRM, analyze profiles, and send 30 personalized messages daily. This will help in maintaining and expanding professional connections on LinkedIn.

Social Media Managers.Title: Facebook Outreach Automation
Social Media Managers.Description: Create the Myte Social Facebook tool to manage the Facebook CRM, analyze profiles, and send 30 personalized messages daily. This will enhance engagement and outreach on Facebook.

Social Media Managers.Title: Automated Article Writing and Posting
Social Media Managers.Description: Develop the Myte Researcher tool to collect news on given topics, allow user input, and craft articles with embedded sources and catchy titles. The tool will post these articles to LinkedIn, Twitter, and the personal website, ensuring regular and informative content updates.

Social Media Managers.Title: Social Media Analytics Dashboard
Social Media Managers.Description: Create a dashboard to track the performance of social media posts and outreach activities. This will provide insights into engagement metrics, helping social media managers optimize their strategies.

Social Media Managers.Title: Human-like Social Media Operations
Social Media Managers.Description: Implement features to ensure that automated tasks, such as posting articles and sending messages, are performed in a human-like manner. This will help avoid detection as automated behavior by social media platforms.

Accounting Team.Title: Automated Invoicing System
Accounting Team.Description: Develop a system to prepare invoices based on account/contact information and hours spent by activity. Integrate the invoicing system with the accounting module to ensure seamless financial tracking and reporting.

Accounting Team.Title: Expense Account Management Mobile App
Accounting Team.Description: Create a mobile application that allows employees to submit expenses by taking pictures of receipts and conversing with an AI system. The app should use a CoT system to analyze conversations and structure expense reports for reimbursement via E-Transfer.

Accounting Team.Title: TD API Integration for Financial Transactions
Accounting Team.Description: Implement a module to connect with the TD API for monitoring business credit card and checking account transactions. Ensure secure and efficient data retrieval to streamline the accounting process and prepare documentation for the CPA.

Accounting Team.Title: Comprehensive Financial Reporting
Accounting Team.Description: Develop a reporting tool within the accounting module to generate comprehensive financial reports. This includes tracking all monetary transactions, preparing necessary documentation for the CPA, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

Accounting Team.Title: Automated Expense Analysis and Reimbursement
Accounting Team.Description: Create an automated system to analyze submitted expenses and process reimbursements. This system should ensure accurate categorization of expenses and streamline the reimbursement process via E-Transfer.

Accounting Team.Title: Secure Data Storage and Backup
Accounting Team.Description: Implement robust security measures for storing financial data on AWS. Ensure regular backups and data encryption to protect sensitive financial information and comply with data privacy regulations.

Accounting Team.Title: User-Friendly Accounting Dashboard
Accounting Team.Description: Design a user-friendly dashboard for the accounting team to view and manage all financial transactions, invoices, and expense reports. The dashboard should provide real-time updates and easy access to financial data.

Accounting Team.Title: Integration with Project Management System
Accounting Team.Description: Ensure seamless integration between the accounting module and the project management system to accurately track hours spent on tasks and generate corresponding invoices. This integration should facilitate efficient financial tracking and reporting.

Employees.Title: Employee Digital Profile Management
Employees.Description: Develop a comprehensive system to maintain digital profiles for all employees, including personal information, job roles, and relevant tracking data. This will enable Project Managers (PMs) to manage all aspects of employee data efficiently.

Employees.Title: Task Assignment and Tracking
Employees.Description: Implement a robust task management system that allows PMs to assign tasks to employees, track task progress, and monitor time spent on each task. This will ensure efficient task distribution and accountability.

Employees.Title: Expense Submission and Management
Employees.Description: Create a mobile application that enables employees to submit expenses by taking pictures of receipts and conversing with an AI system. The AI will analyze the conversations and structure the expense reports for reimbursement via E-Transfer.

Employees.Title: Project Kick-Off and Execution
Employees.Description: Develop a system to distribute project tasks to international coders, allowing them to start and end tasks while tracking the time spent. This will compile time data by contract/coder for invoicing and project management purposes.

Employees.Title: Employee Communication and Collaboration
Employees.Description: Implement features that facilitate communication and collaboration among employees, including internal messaging, shared project boards, and document sharing. This will enhance teamwork and project coordination.

Employees.Title: Performance and Productivity Tracking
Employees.Description: Create tools to monitor and report on employee performance and productivity, including time tracking, task completion rates, and project contributions. This will help in evaluating employee performance and identifying areas for improvement.

Employees.Title: Training and Onboarding
Employees.Description: Develop a comprehensive training and onboarding module that provides new employees with the necessary resources and guidance to get started with the system. This will include tutorials, documentation, and support for new hires.

Employees.Title: Employee Feedback and Improvement
Employees.Description: Implement a feedback system that allows employees to provide input on the usability and functionality of the software. This feedback will be used to make continuous improvements to the system, ensuring it meets the needs of all users.

Clients.Title: Client Portal Access
Clients.Description: Develop a client portal that allows clients to view their contracts, communications, and project progress. The portal will provide a comprehensive overview of all interactions and project statuses, ensuring transparency and easy access to information.

Clients.Title: Client Chatbot Integration
Clients.Description: Integrate a chatbot within the client portal powered by OpenAI API. The chatbot will be trained on client-relevant data, including client emails and progress reports, to provide quick answers and support for client inquiries.

Clients.Title: Proposal Initiation and Tracking
Clients.Description: Enable clients to initiate new proposals through the client portal using the Myte Estimates tool. This feature will allow clients to input their requirements, which will then be evaluated and tracked as leads and proposals by the company.

Clients.Title: Contract Management and Digital Signatures
Clients.Description: Implement a system for creating, sending, and storing contracts digitally. Clients will be able to review and sign contracts electronically, ensuring a seamless and efficient contract management process.

Clients.Title: Progress Report Notifications
Clients.Description: Provide clients with regular updates on project progress through automated notifications. These updates will include detailed reports generated by the Myte Code Checker, ensuring clients are always informed about the status of their projects.

Clients.Title: Communication History Access
Clients.Description: Maintain a comprehensive history of all communications related to each contract within the client portal. Clients will be able to access past emails and messages, ensuring all interactions are well-documented and easily retrievable.

Clients.Title: Invoice and Payment Tracking
Clients.Description: Develop a system for clients to view and track their invoices and payments. This feature will provide a clear overview of all financial transactions related to their contracts, ensuring transparency and ease of financial management.

Clients.Title: Client Feedback and Support
Clients.Description: Implement a feedback and support system within the client portal. Clients will be able to provide feedback on the services received and request support for any issues or inquiries, ensuring continuous improvement and client satisfaction.

Company Management.Title: Comprehensive CRM System
Company Management.Description: Develop a CRM system to manage company, office, and contact information, including automated email extraction and analysis to maintain a comprehensive conversation history.

Company Management.Title: Lead and Opportunity Tracking
Company Management.Description: Implement a system to track new leads and opportunities, monitoring their status until they become proposals, ensuring a streamlined sales process.

Company Management.Title: Proposal and Contract Management
Company Management.Description: Create tools for generating detailed project breakdowns and proposals, sending proposals to clients, and managing digital contracts with a comprehensive contract database.

Company Management.Title: Project Kick-Off and Task Management
Company Management.Description: Develop a system to distribute tasks to international coders, track task progress and time spent, and compile this data for invoicing and project management purposes.

Company Management.Title: Automated Code Analysis and Reporting
Company Management.Description: Implement the Myte Code Checker tool to analyze daily code changes, generate natural language reports, and send updates to clients automatically.

Company Management.Title: Invoicing and Accounting Integration
Company Management.Description: Create an invoicing system linked to the accounting module, integrating with the TD API to monitor financial transactions and prepare documentation for CPAs.

Company Management.Title: Employee Database and Management
Company Management.Description: Develop a comprehensive digital profile system for employees, enabling efficient management and tracking of employee information and tasks.

Company Management.Title: Myte Dashboard
Company Management.Description: Build a dashboard for company management to view CRM data, opportunities, contracts, RFIs, invoices, and other key metrics, including a chatbot for querying company data.

Company Management.Title: Client Portal
Company Management.Description: Develop a client portal for clients to view their contracts, communications, and project progress, interact with a chatbot, and initiate new proposals.

Company Management.Title: Social Media and Content Management
Company Management.Description: Implement tools for automating social media outreach on Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook, and for creating and posting articles to various platforms.

Project Managers.Title: CRM System Development
Project Managers.Description: Develop a comprehensive CRM system to manage company, office, and contact information. This includes extracting and analyzing emails using OpenAI GPT-4o to populate the CRM, maintaining a conversation history, and ensuring continuous syncing of contact information.

Project Managers.Title: Lead and Opportunity Tracking
Project Managers.Description: Implement a system to track new opportunities associated with accounts. This includes monitoring the status of opportunities until they become proposals, ensuring that PMs can manage and follow up on leads effectively.

Project Managers.Title: Proposal Management
Project Managers.Description: Create a tool for preparing project breakdowns and proposals using Myte Estimates. This involves generating detailed PDFs with client requirements, estimated time, cost, and risks, and sending these proposals to clients.

Project Managers.Title: Contract Management System
Project Managers.Description: Develop a system for creating, sending, and digitally storing contracts. This includes linking contracts to employees, maintaining a history of all related communications, and ensuring that all contractual obligations are well-documented and accessible.

Project Managers.Title: Project Kick-Off and Task Management
Project Managers.Description: Implement a project kick-off system to distribute tasks to international coders, track task start and end times, and compile time spent per contract/coder for invoicing. This ensures efficient task management and accurate tracking of project progress.

Project Managers.Title: Project Management and Code Analysis
Project Managers.Description: Develop the Myte Code Checker tool to analyze code changes daily, generate natural language reports, and automatically send updates to contract contacts. This ensures that PMs can keep clients informed about project progress.

Project Managers.Title: Invoicing System
Project Managers.Description: Create a system to prepare invoices based on account/contact information and hours spent by activity. This includes linking the invoicing system to the accounting system to streamline financial processes.

Project Managers.Title: Employee Database Management
Project Managers.Description: Develop a digital profile system for all employees, enabling PMs to manage end-to-end tasks efficiently. This includes maintaining relevant information and ensuring easy access to employee data.

Project Managers.Title: Myte Dashboard Development
Project Managers.Description: Create a comprehensive dashboard for PMs to view CRM data, opportunities, contact conversations, current contracts, leads, active proposals, and more. This includes integrating a chatbot to answer questions about company data.

Project Managers.Title: Client Portal Development
Project Managers.Description: Develop a client portal where clients can view their contracts, communications, and project progress. This includes integrating a chatbot for quick answers and enabling clients to initiate new proposals using Myte Estimates.

AI System Developers.Title: Email Extraction and Analysis System
AI System Developers.Description: Develop a system to extract emails from Gmail and analyze them using OpenAI GPT-4o. This includes extracting details like Name, Company Name, Address, and Phone Number, and maintaining a conversation history for each contact.

AI System Developers.Title: AI-Powered CRM Initialization
AI System Developers.Description: Implement AI models to initialize the CRM by analyzing historical emails to populate contact details and conversation history. Ensure continuous syncing to keep contact information up-to-date.

AI System Developers.Title: AI-Driven Proposal Generation
AI System Developers.Description: Integrate Myte Estimates tool to use AI for generating detailed project breakdowns and proposals. This includes estimating time, cost, and identifying risks based on client requirements.

AI System Developers.Title: AI-Based Contract Management
AI System Developers.Description: Develop AI systems to create, send, and manage contracts digitally. This includes linking contracts to relevant employees and maintaining a history of all related communications.

AI System Developers.Description: Build Myte Code Checker to analyze code changes daily using OpenAI Transformers and generate natural language reports. Ensure the system can handle large codebases and provide accurate updates.

AI System Developers.Title: AI-Enhanced Invoicing System
AI System Developers.Description: Develop an AI system to prepare invoices based on account/contact information and hours spent by activity. Integrate this system with the accounting module for seamless financial management.

AI System Developers.Title: AI-Powered Social Media Automation
AI System Developers.Description: Implement AI tools like Myte Twitter, Myte Social LinkedIn, and Myte Social Facebook to automate social media outreach and content creation. Ensure the system can operate in a human-like manner to avoid detection by social media platforms.

AI System Developers.Description: Develop Myte Researcher to collect news on given topics, allow user input, and craft articles with sources and catchy titles. Automate the posting of these articles to LinkedIn, Twitter, and personal websites.

AI System Developers.Description: Create a mobile app with AI capabilities to submit expenses via receipt photos and voice inputs. Use a CoT system to analyze conversations and structure expense reports for reimbursement.

AI System Developers.Description: Develop a client portal with AI chatbot capabilities to provide clients with access to their contracts, communications, and project progress. Ensure the chatbot can provide quick answers and assist in initiating new proposals.
